The free CamScanner replacement. No ads. No watermark. No account. No subscription. Not now, not ever.

Remember CamScanner? The ads in the way of every scan. Its \"Scanned with CamScanner\" stamped across your own documents. The \"free trial\" that quietly turns into $49.99 a year. You can uninstall it now. Everything it charges you for is right here, for nothing.

Auto-fix cleans every page as it\'s saved: curved pages straightened, fingers and handwriting taken out, desk in the corners made paper
Notices when you scan the same page twice
Import photos and PDFs you already have
Pages that look scanned, not photographed
Looks for every job: Auto, Bright, Gray, Ink, Board, and Photo for old prints
Clean up takes out handwriting, fingers, coffee stains and the back page showing through
Sign, draw, highlight, add text and stamps, or retype a word on the page

Searchable PDFs, small PDFs and password-locked PDFs
